authorization.scope: One separate exact-upstream signed-int8 compatibility experiment.

objective: Determine whether the pinned MapLight fixed representation can be generated on all frozen shadow rows when Morgan and Avalon counts use the pinned upstream zero-length numpy.int8 conversion exactly.
hypothesis: Exact upstream signed-int8 conversion yields two builds with byte-identical row and array payloads for the row-aligned, label-free 2,563-value representation without changing any other Stage A input or feature rule.
targeted_failure_mode: The exact upstream conversion may drift, fail, or produce nondeterministic wrapped count arrays on real rows.

inheritance.rule: Every clause in the hash-bound safe Stage A contract remains normative unless its exact JSON pointer appears in overrides. Child clauses extend rather than replace inherited clauses unless named as a replacement.
inheritance.model_authority: The compatible roots may feed only the already frozen Stage A candidate ladder after both roots and their repeat gate pass independent review. They grant no new candidate, fit, seed, target, scoring, or public-test authority.

sole_scientific_change.conversion: Pass each pinned RDKit sparse count fingerprint to rdkit.DataStructs.ConvertToNumpyArray with a zero-length C-contiguous numpy.int8 buffer, exactly as the pinned MapLight source does.
sole_scientific_change.preconversion_validation: Require sparse indices and counts to be non-boolean integers, indices to be within the declared 1,024 dimensions, and counts to be nonnegative. Do not impose an upper count bound.
sole_scientific_change.overflow_semantics: Values above 127 use the pinned RDKit and NumPy signed-int8 conversion result. Do not widen, clip, binarize, post-correct, or reinterpret the resulting bytes.

compatibility_parity.fixture: Reuse the exact eight-row parent fixture. For every fixture value within the safe range, require exact upstream-versus-compatible-implementation equality for the four MapLight fixed blocks, the complete matrix, C-order element bytes, and non-pickle numpy v1.0 bytes. Binary Morgan is local-only: require it to match the prior safe parity receipt and both fresh compatible processes exactly; do not call it upstream parity.
compatibility_parity.boundary_operation: For each count, create a four-dimensional RDKit UIntSparseIntVect with bin 1 set to that value and convert it through a zero-length C-contiguous numpy.int8 buffer. Require both fresh compatible processes and one direct pinned-upstream operation to emit the declared bytes.

failure_accounting.semantics: Use exactly the success-accounting key set. Record observed attempted and completed operations. Retained arrays are zero unless a complete success root is atomically promoted; real rows and all scientific counters remain zero.

compatibility_parity.scientific_accounting: No real row, label, fit, prediction, metric, GIN, challenge, or public-test operation.

unchanged_rules.raw_input_policy: Use each exact frozen raw TDC Drug string with Chem.MolFromSmiles defaults. Cache only by the exact raw UTF-8 bytes and raw SHA-256; never by standardized hash.
unchanged_rules.row_policy: Preserve all 30,038 official train_val rows, including duplicates and conflicting structure-task cells, in frozen row order.

execution.cache_scope: Each build independently featurizes all 15,399 exact-raw inputs. Any feature cache is process-local and dies with that build. Build 2 may inspect build 1 only during preflight validation and final byte comparison, never during feature generation.
execution.build_2_precondition: Before build 2 resolves shadow rows, require the complete immutable build-1 success root, validate every manifest field and output hash against this contract, require the compatibility parity success root, and require both build-1 and compatibility-parity blocker roots to be absent. Otherwise stop before resolving scientific input and preserve one immutable build-2 failure receipt with zero completed feature operations.
execution.repeat_gate: Before any model work, require identical feature_rows.csv bytes and identical bytes for all five block arrays. Require identical contracts, inputs, implementation, compatibility parity, overflow statistics, population, environment, and scientific-zero accounting. Manifest differences are limited to build_id, prior_build, runtime_seconds, peak_rss_gib, and per-build versus cumulative feature-operation counts.

overflow_receipt.statistic_population: All 15,399 unique exact-raw inputs before expansion to 30,038 source rows.

accounting_shape.scientific_zeros: object with exactly scientific_zero_fields; every value is the non-boolean integer zero

success_manifest.accounting_value_order: Every expected-accounting array follows operation_accounting_fields exactly.

failure_receipt.rules: Use null only for inapplicable safe fields. Record no raw structure. Remove every partial staging root before writing one immutable failure receipt. Count attempted and fully completed operations separately.
failure_receipt.accounting_shape: Use the exact success-manifest accounting_shape and field lists. Failure counts are observed rather than predeclared.

firewall.scope: This child firewall governs compatibility parity and the two feature builds only.
allowed_scientific_inputs: fresh compatibility parity success receipt and root
firewall.downstream_handoff: After both compatible roots and their repeat gate pass independent review, the inherited parent process_firewall.model_cell_process and process_firewall.score_process govern Stage A model and scoring work.

acceptance: The fresh compatibility parity receipt passes the eight-row fixture and exact 127, 128, and 144 signed-int8 boundaries under the frozen environment.
Both real builds complete with 30,038 row-aligned rows and five block arrays of the declared dimensions and dtypes.
The two row files and ten corresponding array files are byte-identical across builds.
Both manifests bind the same contract, source, environment, parity, shadow, code, and output hashes.
Every overflow statistic is recorded and agrees across builds.
No label, model, prediction, metric, GIN, challenge, or public-test operation occurs.
stopping_rules: Stop on any contract, source, environment, parity, shadow, revision, row, hash, schema, dimension, dtype, finiteness, resource, or repeat mismatch.
Stop if signed-int8 boundary values 127, -128, and -112 are not exact at bin 1 for preconversion counts 127, 128, and 144.
Stop if any rule other than the declared count upper-bound behavior must change.
Preserve a compact immutable failure receipt and do not repair after seeing any model or metric result.
next_gate: Independent review of this pre-result contract and its implementation is required before the signed-int8 witness or any real compatibility feature row is generated. Independent review of both completed feature roots is required before any Stage A model fit.
reversal_condition: Reject this experiment if it cannot reproduce the exact upstream signed-int8 bytes without another scientific change. Never rewrite or delete the safe experiment or its blocker.
